visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Five individuals stand in a formation on an urban walkway at night. The central figure is a woman with long red-brown hair wearing a black lace jumpsuit and a dark blazer. To her left is a woman in a pink long-sleeved shirt and brown shorts; behind her is a girl in a school uniform-style outfit. To the center's right are two men, one in a plaid shirt and another in a white track jacket. Brightly lit skyscrapers, including one with a blue 'Citi' logo, dominate the background. (2) The central woman waves towards the camera while the other four dancers begin moving their arms in a coordinated rhythm. The scene is brightly lit by multi-colored urban lights and street lamps. (3) The group performs a synchronized dance routine involving rhythmic hip sways, pointing gestures, and arm extensions. The camera is fixed at eye level, capturing the full body of the dancers as they move in unison. (4) The dancers conclude the routine by forming heart shapes with their hands and smiling toward the lens. The background remains consistent with static city lights and distant passers-by.

A female vocalist enters with a clear, high-arousal tone singing energetic Mandarin lyrics. The mix is clean with a high harmonic-to-noise ratio. (2) The song continues with a steady tempo of 126 BPM. The vocal delivery remains consistent and bright, with subtle pitch modulations that suggest a playful and happy mood. There is no background noise or environmental interference. (3) The arrangement layers more synthesized melodic elements during a chorus section. The beat is strong and percussive, dominating the mid-range frequencies while the vocals sit clearly on top. No incidental sound effects are present. (4) The vocal sustains a final melodic note as the instrumental track begins a smooth fade-out. The spectral brightness remains high until the final second, ending in a clean studio silence.
